scientific_integrity: A derivation based on exact joint moments and a simultaneous-last-edge density; finite rational checks are supplementary, not proofs of limits. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent rate-one clocks on distinct edges of complete bipartite graphs. The exact finite tie law covers part sizes at least two. The rare-event coefficient and conditional gamma law assume that both part sizes are asymptotically equal and that the logarithmically normalized part-size difference has a finite limit. No divergent imbalance or other graph-family extension is claimed. Historical two-class coupon collector literature is incompletely inspectable; priority is not guaranteed.
title: A sharp simultaneous last-isolation law for bipartite edge clocks
